title: Loch Maree Hotel
geometryBasis: The existing hotel is identified by its mapped name and distinct building entity. The nineteenth-century photograph-derived engraving constrains the original frontage and side proportions. Present outline is the positional tie.
sectionBasis: The October 1877 issue of The Graphic shows the paired sash windows, recessed main entry, dormer, prominent gables, chimney stacks and southeast bay.
limitations: The model depicts the 1877 exterior described in the story. The later enlargement and present additions are from a different phase.
The original geometry is an estimate registered to the surviving inn. Lake-facing elevations and exact chimneys, masonry tones, roof details and glazing are interpreted.
